## Definition of done

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …); it becomes the changelog line
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, format, types, tests); no `any` in `core`/`vision`
- [ ] Unit tests for new logic; E2E test for any user journey touched (once E2E exists)
- [ ] New user-facing errors have a `TS-<AREA>-<NNN>` code and catalogue entry
- [ ] Docs / ADR updated if behaviour or a recorded decision changed
- [ ] Event-file schema or results-format change noted (migration added / schema version bumped)

## Privacy

- [ ] No real rider names, entry lists, licence numbers, or card photos showing names
- [ ] Nothing copied from a commercial scoring workbook
